# Requirements Quality Checklist: Use Case Flow Specification

**Purpose**: Validate clarity, completeness, and consistency of requirements in spec.md and plan.md
**Created**: 2026-02-10
**Feature**: .specify/spec.md

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all user stories mapped to explicit functional requirements? [Traceability, Spec §User Scenarios, Spec §FR-001–FR-040]
- [ ] CHK002 Are out-of-scope items explicitly documented to prevent scope creep? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK003 Are required paper metadata fields explicitly specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK004 Are manuscript file format and size limits explicitly specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK005 Are required review fields explicitly specified? [Gap, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK006 Are attendance types explicitly enumerated or constrained? [Gap, Spec §FR-039]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is "password complexity" defined with concrete rules (e.g., character classes)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-003, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "invalid draft information" defined with specific validation rules? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "standard conference size" in scheduling performance defined with measurable bounds? [Ambiguity, Spec §SC-004]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the retention period anchored to a precise "conference end date" definition? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-040]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Are username and email uniqueness rules consistent across registration and login flows? [Consistency, Spec §FR-002, Spec §FR-007]
- [ ] CHK012 Do role constraints in the flows align with all role-based requirements? [Consistency, Spec §User Scenarios, Spec §FR-021–FR-033]
- [ ] CHK013 Is the tech stack in plan.md consistent with constitution constraints (C++ and style guide)? [Consistency, Plan §Technical Context, Constitution]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK014 Are all success criteria measurable and verifiable without implementation details? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-005]
- [ ] CHK015 Are success criteria defined for each major workflow area (auth, submissions, reviews, scheduling, registration)? [Completeness, Spec §SC-001–SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are alternate flows for all user stories captured in requirements (not only in narratives)? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios]
- [ ] CHK017 Are notification requirements (channel, timing) explicitly specified for all flows that notify users? [Gap, Spec §FR-025, Spec §FR-033, Spec §FR-038]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for unauthorized access attempts across all protected flows? [Coverage, Spec §User Scenarios]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Are duplicate submission rules defined for drafts, reviews, and decisions beyond the stated examples? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK020 Are conflict resolution rules specified for concurrent schedule edits? [Gap, Spec §FR-036]
- [ ] CHK021 Are retry/rollback requirements specified for system errors during save operations? [Gap, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK022 Are performance targets defined for authentication and submission flows in addition to scheduling? [Gap, Spec §SC-001–SC-004]
- [ ] CHK023 Are availability/recovery expectations defined for the CMS (uptime, restore targets)? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are privacy handling requirements specified for data deletion after retention ends? [Gap, Spec §FR-040]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK025 Are external dependencies (payment service, email delivery) specified with failure handling requirements? [Gap, Spec §User Story 12, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 6]
- [ ] CHK026 Are assumptions about rooms/time slots and registration state explicitly linked to requirements? [Clarity, Spec §Assumptions & Dependencies]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK027 Are any requirements using terms like "valid" or "invalid" without definition? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-015, Spec §FR-019, Spec §FR-029]
- [ ] CHK028 Is there an explicit requirement/acceptance mapping for UAT items to FRs? [Traceability, Spec §UAT]

## Notes

- Check items off as completed: `[x]`

- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
